rows.name: EEA Free Movement
rows.description: Top-level EEA free movement pathway family. Applies to nationals of EEA member states moving to other EEA countries. Sub-pathways specify purpose (employment, study, self-employment, etc.).

rows.name: EEA Free Movement — Employment (Norway)
rows.description: EEA nationals exercising free movement rights in Norway for the purpose of employment. Under EEA Agreement Article 28, nationals of EEA states have the right to work in Norway without a work permit. Key obligations: EEA registration with police (90-day rule), D-number application, tax card, and national registry if staying >6 months.

rows.name: EU Blue Card — Germany
rows.description: Highly qualified non-EU nationals working in Germany under the EU Blue Card scheme. Requires a recognised higher education qualification and a binding job offer with salary at or above the threshold.
